---
title: inif.indexed
description: Indexed archive format — incremental writes, lower-level save/load, partial sample selection.
reference: inif.indexed
---

The single-file indexed archive (`.inif`) stores metadata and sequences
once, then writes each sample as a separate compressed member. The
top-level `save` / `load` dispatch automatically calls into this module
when the path ends in `.inif`; the entry points below expose the
lower-level options (custom compression level, max preview-text length,
partial loads via `sample_ids=`).

For format-agnostic readers (`iter_samples`, `read_samples`, `read_info`)
that work on both `.inif` and `.inif.json` files, see
[`inif.io`](inif.io.qmd). The legacy indexed-only readers
(`iter_indexed_samples`, `read_indexed_*`) are no longer part of the
public API.

See [Saving and loading](../workflows/io.qmd#indexed-archive) for the
narrative overview.
